steps: Go to the official ySense site and sign up for free, then verify your email address.
Complete your profile surveys so ySense can match you with surveys, tasks, and offers (earnings accrue in USD — there are no points to convert).
Take surveys, complete offers/tasks, and use the Daily Checklist for bonuses; check availability frequently since survey inventory varies by country.

Before your first PayPal cashout: make sure your ySense name and email EXACTLY match your PayPal name/email, link a bank account to PayPal and get it confirmed, and (if in the US/Canada) verify your postal address with ySense.
On your account summary page, click the 'Cashout' link (it appears only once you reach the minimum cashout amount) and choose PayPal, Payoneer, or Skrill.
Expect processing of up to 10 business days — up to 15 business days for a new account or first cashout — and no more than 2 cashouts per day.
timing: Cashouts processed in up to 10 business days; up to 15 business days for new accounts (registered within 30 days) or first cashout. Max 2 cashouts per day.
